rules.GT: fixed source hash before single decode; mode1/L; exact native shape; values subset of {0,1} OR {0,255}; nonzero->1; no resize/dilation
rules.pixel_AP: frozen fewshot_synthetic.metrics.exact_ap; all native pixels once; no sampling, padding or mean per-image AP
rules.ties: float32 exact bit-value grouping; -0 normalized to +0; frozen descending scan; native N and actual P plus independent table count/tie checks
rules.image_AUROC: sklearn roc_auc_score on all1004 original native maxima; only defined with both GT classes
rules.classification: score strictly greater than original Q threshold; TP/FN on actual anomaly, FP/TN on actual normal; equality is normal
rules.empty: NA/null with reason for zero denominator/no positives/single-class AUROC; never silently omit images
rules.examples: first ID in original ascending E order for each TP/FN/FP/TN; empty group NA; deduplicate and retain all reasons
rules.reuse: complete same identity read-only verification; partial/unknown/failure preserve and stop; no resume/reaccumulation/retry

resource.checks: entry, each GT, each AP chunk, table-check chunks; frozen exact scan has entry gate only, not continuous monitoring

probe_crosscheck.evidence: sealed same21 training-window AP/sklearn/actual ties; not recomputed

GT_class_and_positive_denominators: unknown until explicit CPU compute decodes all GT
scope: E historically seen, single seed/fixed R5/split/class, unknown acquisition groups; exploratory only, no screen claim
